formation.quote: the Proposal of the NA49-future Collaboration to study hadron production in hadron – proton interactions and nucleus – nucleus collisions at the Cern-SPS was submitted to the SPSC on November 3, 2006

intervals.label: collaboration: Long Shutdown 3 (no SPS beam)
intervals.note: Restart is a plan ("from 2028 onwards"); NA61/SHINE has proposed a further programme (arXiv:2025 strategy proposal, not read).
intervals.quote: CERN’s injector complex and Antimatter Factory took their final steps towards Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) this morning, as the last particle beams were extracted and the machines fell silent.

summary.technical: NA61/SHINE Collaboration (about 140 physicists, 28 institutions, 14 countries per the experiment website; spokespersons Seweryn Kowalski and Eric Zimmerman); formed from the NA49 collaboration, proposal submitted to the SPSC in November 2006, approved February 2007.
